subject: Housekeeping ask: prune the superseded Mac branches (the Mac classifier blocks branch deletion)
body: lane:inbox lists 90 origin/mac/* branches mainline does not carry; the owner's estate list (docs/agent/estate-20261023/branches-unmerged.md, branches.json) and your prune list name the superseded ones, including mac/pr1840-accuracy-aa2-efdd6a23a41947468095be6e55964182 (a28a8881) and the fix1840/fix1840b tips that #1840 superseded. You have write access to all repos since 09:30Z; please delete the ones on the prune list and reply with the count. Nothing with an open PR, nothing not on the list.
